Footsteps. Echoes. Silence.

There must be silence.

Home, safety, serenity.

Silence.

Sleep, quiet, sanctuary.

Silence.

Fear, terror, alone.

Silence.

Panic. Stumble. Fall.

Noise. 

Death. 

Silence.
